page.title: Computers

page.live_tooltip: Real-time updates · offline detection up to 75s

machine.workspaces_truncated: List truncated — some directories were not returned
machine.workspace_delete_no_permission: Only this computer's owner can delete

delete_computer.toast_deleted_cloud: Deleted cloud computer "{{name}}" and its container.

operation_failed.title: Operation failed. Nothing was changed.
operation_failed.description: "{{name}}" was not deleted and its agents are unchanged. Try again later.

confirm.title: Delete this computer from this workspace?
confirm.description: Deleted server data cannot be recovered. "{{name}}", its runtimes, and all archived agents on it ({{count}} total), including their server history and messages, will be permanently deleted from this workspace. Files on the computer and its other workspaces are not affected. You can connect the computer again later as a new connection.
confirm.description_cloud: This cannot be undone. "{{name}}" and its cloud container will be permanently deleted, along with archived agents on it ({{count}} total) and their history.
confirm.type_to_confirm: Type the computer name "{{name}}" to confirm.

blocked_by_agents.title: Cannot delete this computer
blocked_by_agents.description: Delete every agent on this computer first, then try again.

blocked_missing_daemon.title: Cannot delete this computer
blocked_missing_daemon.description: "{{name}}" has no Computer ID, so one-click delete is unavailable. Per-runtime delete is not used as a substitute.

blocked_missing_sandbox.title: Cannot delete this cloud computer
blocked_missing_sandbox.description: "{{name}}" is missing its sandbox id, so the cloud container cannot be deleted from here.

ops.upgrade_progress_pending: Waiting for the Computer to accept the update…
ops.upgrade_failed_unknown: Please retry or use the manual command.
ops.upgrade_owner_only: Only the computer owner can upgrade

danger_zone.title: Danger Zone
danger_zone.description: Permanently remove this computer and its runtimes from the current workspace. Local files and other workspaces are not affected. All agents must be removed first.
danger_zone.description_cloud: Permanently delete this cloud computer, its container, and its runtimes from the workspace.

online.label: Online
online.description: Heartbeat received in the last 45s. Ready to dispatch tasks.

recently_lost.label: Recently lost
recently_lost.description: Lost contact under 5 minutes ago — often a brief network blip.

offline.label: Offline
offline.description: No heartbeat for 5+ minutes. Restart the Computer or investigate the host.

about_to_gc.label: About to GC
about_to_gc.description: Offline 6+ days. Auto-deleted at 7 days unless it reconnects.

detail.no_agents: No agents are bound to this runtime yet.

final.title: Delete Runtime?
final.description: Are you sure you want to delete "{{name}}"? This action cannot be undone.

blocked_by_agents.title_one: {{count}} agent is still on this runtime
blocked_by_agents.title_other: {{count}} agents are still on this runtime
blocked_by_agents.description: Delete or archive the agents below before you can delete "{{name}}".
blocked_by_agents.notice_runtime_has_active_agents: Active agents were added since you opened this dialog — showing the current list.

blocked_by_online_daemon.title: Stop the Computer first
blocked_by_online_daemon.description: "{{name}}" is a running local Computer and will automatically re-register itself within seconds of being deleted here. Stop it on the device first.
blocked_by_online_daemon.waiting_hint: We'll detect when it goes offline and let you finish deleting it.

delete_dialog.self_healing_blocked_toast: This Computer is managed by a running local Computer and will re-register itself.

add_computer.title: Add computer
add_computer.description: Choose how you want to add a computer to this workspace.
add_computer.your_computer_hint: Run agents on a computer you control.
add_computer.cloud_hint: Create a Docker container on a connected sandbox node.

create_cloud_computer.title: Create cloud computer
create_cloud_computer.description: Choose a name, sandbox node, and Docker image. Runtime models can be edited after creation.
create_cloud_computer.provisioning_hint: Starting this cloud computer. It will show as connected once the Computer registers.

connect.title: Connect computer
connect.description: Install Multica on this computer, then complete setup to connect it to this workspace.
connect.step2_hint: Opens a browser to sign in, connects this Workspace, then keeps the Computer resident running in the background.
connect.live_listening_hint: Keep this dialog open. It will continue automatically when the computer is registered.
connect.troubleshooting: Can't open a browser on that computer?
connect.install_trouble_retry: Check your internet connection and try the command again — a one-off network blip is the most common cause.
connect.install_trouble_network: If you're on a work network, VPN, or firewall, it may be blocking outbound access to the install script. Try a different network, or ask whoever manages it to allow this connection.
connect.trouble_intro: Step 2 already handles this — it prints a link and a one-time code you can confirm from your phone or another computer. No browser needed on this machine.
connect.success_description: Your computer is online and ready. Create an agent and it can start picking up tasks here.

cloud_runtime.title: Cloud Runtime
cloud_runtime.description: Launch a managed cloud node and watch its Fleet status.
cloud_runtime.create_hint: Choose a name, instance type, and disk size. Fleet applies the rest.
cloud_runtime.nodes_failed_hint: Fleet did not return a node list.
cloud_runtime.toast_create_failed: Failed to create Cloud Runtime node
cloud_runtime.delete_confirm: Are you sure you want to delete this cloud node? This action cannot be undone.

validation.disk_size_invalid: Disk size must be a positive integer

update.managed_by_desktop_title: The CLI binary is managed by Multica Desktop — update Desktop to upgrade the CLI.
update.managed_by_sandbox_title: This machine is managed by its sandbox environment — it can't self-update from here.
update.last_update_not_applied: Last update did not take effect. Still running {{currentVersion}} after attempting {{targetVersion}}. Retry or view the reason.
update.manual_hint: Upgrades are explicit machine operations. If this computer cannot complete one, update it from a terminal on that computer.
update.manual_dialog_description: Run the command that matches the runtime computer. The macOS/Linux command reinstalls the CLI from the current Multica release source.
update.manual_after_restart: After the command finishes, the Computer reconnects with the new CLI version. If it stays offline, run multica computer restart once more.

status.queued: Queued — will start when this runtime is next online.
status.ready_to_apply: Update is ready. It will apply when this runtime is idle.

update.pin_blocked: Upgrades are disabled — this computer is pinned to v{{version}}. Remove the pin to allow upgrades.
update.pin_blocked_toast: Can't upgrade — this computer is pinned to v{{version}}.

restart.confirm_description: This interrupts any agents currently working on this machine. The Computer reconnects automatically once it comes back up.

status.delivered: Restart delivered. Waiting for the Computer to reconnect...

list.delete_permission_hint: Only the runtime owner can delete this runtime
list.delete_admin_hint: Only the runtime owner can delete a runtime.
